scene.accessibleHeading: flausen. — an everyday OS for work, creativity and play

sections.label: Play
sections.heading: Make room for play.
sections.body: Games are part of a full PC experience. flausen. brings play into an everyday desktop built for work, creativity and everything in between.
sections.note: In development. Availability and compatibility details will follow when verified.

sections.label: Everyday
sections.heading: A desktop for your whole day.
sections.body: Work, create, browse, listen and keep things organized. flausen. aims to bring familiar desktop ideas together in one consistent experience, with the technical machinery kept out of your way.
sections.note: This describes the direction of the project, not a released feature list.

sections.label: The idea
sections.heading: A little out of line.
sections.body: flausen. is a personal project by ralleur: an everyday OS built on CachyOS, combining familiar ideas from Windows and macOS with the flexibility of KDE and Caelestia.
sections.note: The name stays flausen. The rest is still taking shape.

copyStatus: Proposed English copy for implementation; do not invent release claims.
